text: ひとり　なのに　すごいわね！

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with surprise at what follows; after a thing-word it needs な in front. ひとり　なのに = 'even though you're alone'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ gives a soft, feminine tone, and ね adds 'aren't you'. すごいわね = 'you're amazing, aren't you'.
